query_lines: -- Testa Multiplos Registros Correntes (ID Duplicado no momento atual)
SELECT cod_filial FROM logiflow.silver.dim_empresas WHERE is_current = TRUE GROUP BY cod_filial HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
-- Testa Fechamento de Tempo (Data Inicio maior ou igual a Data Fim)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM logiflow.silver.dim_empresas WHERE effective_start >= effective_end
LEAD(effective_start) OVER (PARTITION BY cod_filial ORDER BY effective_start) AS next_start
) z WHERE next_start IS NOT NULL AND effective_end > next_start
